2609.02244.title: Task-Level Natural Language Priors as Learning Signals for Low-Resource LLM Training
2609.02244.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) often struggle when low-resource training data are ambiguous or incomplete. Task-level natural-language priors can provide useful guidance in such settings, but existing approaches usually treat these priors as input context rather than as learning signals during training. We propose Prior-Guided Tuning (PGT), a training perspective that incorporates natural-language priors as auxiliary learning signals for low-resource LLM training. Under this perspective, we introduce Contrastive Prior Steering (CPS), which keeps the original supervised objective intact while adding positive and negative prior-conditioned auxiliary losses to encourage task-consistent learning and discourage plausible but misleading alternatives. Experiments on AmbiMath, Jigsaw, and MNLI/HANS show that CPS consistently improves over plain and prompt fine-tuning. On AmbiMath, CPS achieves 97.6% average exact-match accuracy. On Jigsaw, CPS improves average Macro F1 by 9.5 percentage points over standard fine-tuning, and with 1/10 of the experimental training data slightly exceeds full-data plain fine-tuning. On HANS, CPS improves non-entailment accuracy by 8.3 and 5.2 percentage points for LLaMA 3.1 8B and Qwen 2.5 7B, respectively, while maintaining comparable in-domain MNLI accuracy. These results support our central claim: task-level natural-language priors can provide useful guidance as auxiliary learning signals for low-resource LLM training. Our code and data will be publicly available.
2609.02244.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在低資源訓練數據模糊或不完整時常常面臨挑戰。任務級自然語言先驗知識可以在這種情況下提供有用的指導，但現有的方法通常將這些先驗知識視為輸入上下文，而不是在訓練過程中的學習信號。我們提出了先驗引導調整（PGT），這是一種將自然語言先驗知識作為低資源LLM訓練的輔助學習信號的訓練觀點。在這一觀點下，我們引入了對比先驗引導（CPS），它保持原始的監督目標不變，同時添加正向和負向的先驗條件輔助損失，以促進任務一致的學習並抑制似是而非但具有誤導性的替代方案。在AmbiMath、Jigsaw和MNLI/HANS上的實驗顯示，CPS在普通和提示微調上均有持續改善。在AmbiMath上，CPS達到97.6%的平均精確匹配準確率。在Jigsaw上，CPS的平均宏F1比標準微調提高了9.5個百分點，並且在使用1/10的實驗訓練數據的情況下，略微超過了全數據的普通微調。在HANS上，CPS對LLaMA 3.1 8B和Qwen 2.5 7B的非蕴涵準確率分別提高了8.3和5.2個百分點，同時保持了相當的領域內MNLI準確率。這些結果支持我們的核心主張：任務級自然語言先驗知識可以作為低資源LLM訓練的輔助學習信號提供有用的指導。我們的代碼和數據將公開提供。
